findings.status: main/older selected heads only; corrected in release/completion/latest
findings.title: Thirty-day privacy-set count can be presented without its partial-range qualifier
evidence: main apps/web/src/lib/scanSpam.ts:170-196 checks seven-day range for partial but reports both seven and thirty day counts
e22 same file switches partial boundary to from30
findings.impact: A scan covering the recent seven days but not the thirty-day range can render the thirty-day count without the lower-bound qualifier, understating the sampled privacy set and implying complete coverage. No spending authority impact.
findings.remediation: Retain latest from30 partial-range calculation; static regression criterion should cover seven-to-thirty-day scan starts.

findings.status: current candidate; independently confirmed by root; main lacks this private-scan path
findings.title: Private scanning drops session-only RPC selections, including a chosen independent secondary provider
evidence: e22 Settings.tsx101-109 registers session-only retention then app.updateSettings(next)
e22 AppShell.tsx421-436 preserves next in React state then saves stripped disk representation
e22 settings.ts195-204 strips session-only primary and secondary URLs; loadSettings reads disk only
e22 defaultServices.ts116 enables privateScanStore in production
e22 Scan.tsx92-98 currentScanSettings returns disk preferences when readable; 166-175 uses these for private scan scope
e22 Scan.tsx434-447 primary absence yields explicit scan.error.noRpc; 450-467, when plan.useSecondary=true, absent persisted secondary skips opening without refusal
findings.impact: A normally saved primary plus same-tab session-only secondary results in scanning without the chosen independent cross-check. No forged payment or fund loss is established. A session-only primary with no custom scan endpoint instead fails visibly and closed (Low availability aspect).
findings.remediation: Use a single current-revision selected endpoint snapshot that retains validated current-tab session-only primary and secondary entries. Preserve the chosen secondary requirement and refuse if that selected provider cannot be opened. Do not persist its credential-bearing URL.
safe_acceptance_criteria: Same-tab Settings save with session-only primary remains usable by production privateScanStore flow without localStorage retention.
Session-only secondary with plan.useSecondary=true is used alongside the selected primary; unusable selected secondary blocks scanning.
Cross-tab stale persisted revisions still revoke/reload rather than reusing obsolete session-only selections.
required_conditions: Current tab saves a selected RPC endpoint as session-only.
For the Medium integrity consequence: primary is otherwise usable, selected secondary is session-only, and plan.useSecondary is true.
findings.independent_confirmation: Root independently confirmed the Settings -> AppShell -> settings persistence -> Scan primary/secondary source chain at e22.
